title: Immersion and coefficient transport of the lisse residue lifting input
statement: Let X and S be Noetherian schemes [def-pc-scheme], i:S→X a locally closed immersion (a closed immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion] followed by an open immersion [def-weil-open-immersion]), and A a complete Noetherian commutative ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], [def-weil-pbc-adically-complete-ring] with maximal ideal I. Suppose K is derived complete with completed coefficients, its residue is represented by a fixed-scalar etale complex C [def-sfb-adic-stratified-perfect-data], C has cohomology in [a,b], and every cohomology sheaf becomes finite locally constant on S. Transporting to the equivalent small site models [def-weil-size-convention] and constant-ring module categories [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] produces a complete object M and an etale residue C′ [def-sfb-adic-residue-lift-comparisons]. The cohomology of C′ vanishes outside [a,b] and is locally constant of finite type [def-weil-pbc-locally-constant-finite-type-modules]. For every K-flat representative [def-pc-kflat-complex] of C′ and every degree-zero module sheaf, its total tensor has cohomology in [a,b]. The actual derived residue projection of M is isomorphic to the comparison pullback of C′. For each pro-etale object U of S [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], there is an equivalence of the standard derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] of completed-coefficient modules on the model slice and true inverse-image coefficients on the original slice. It identifies restricted M with sfbLocalRestriction of K and, for every A-complex P, the completed constant realization of P with sfbLocalRestriction of sfbCompletedModel(P). The etale site is [def-weil-pbc-etale-site]. No covering or perfect representative is asserted.

proof.text: Use the explicit etale inverse-image coefficient model as C′. Exact transport preserves the cohomological interval.
Finite lisse etale cohomology gives finite local module values in this fixed model.
Maximality of I identifies A/I with a field. Apply constant-field tensor bounds to every representative of C′ and every degree-zero module sheaf. K-flatness is unnecessary for this clause.

The independent completed transport theorem supplies M, its completeness, its residue isomorphism to this C′, and its two slice comparisons. Assemble these witnesses and the preceding cohomological properties.
